title: Summary
text: This session completed the final three sprints of the AgentWiki roadmap, delivering the full Phase 6 Agent API and upgrading the graph visualization layer. Sprint 3 introduced a FastAPI REST layer with five endpoints: GET /nodes, GET /nodes/{id}, GET /search, GET /neighbors/{id}, and GET /stats. The API reads from the compiled dist/ directory and is wired into the CLI via uv run agentwiki serve. Sprint 4 added an MCP server exposing the same five capabilities as MCP tools over stdio, allowing Claude Code and Claude Desktop to call list_nodes, get_node, search_nodes, get_neighbors, and get_stats directly from the compiled knowledge graph. Sprint 5 replaced the hand-rolled canvas-based force layout on the graph page with Cytoscape.js. A GlobalGraph.astro component handles the full knowledge graph view using cose layout, and a new LocalGraph.astro component renders per-node neighborhood graphs using concentric layout directly on node detail pages. The Astro build produces 178 pages cleanly. All phases of the AgentWiki roadmap (Phases 0 through 6) are now implemented.

title: Files Changed
text: compiler/api.py created: FastAPI app with 5 REST endpoints; lru_cache plus set_dist_dir for test isolation. compiler/mcp_server.py created: MCP Server with 5 tools over stdio; build_server factory plus serve_stdio. compiler/cli.py modified: added serve command (uvicorn) and mcp command. tests/test_api.py created: 5 FastAPI tests using TestClient plus tmp_path fixture. tests/test_mcp_server.py created: 6 MCP server unit tests; tests tool registration and all handlers. site/src/components/GlobalGraph.astro created: Cytoscape.js cose layout; CDN-loaded; node click navigation. site/src/components/LocalGraph.astro created: Cytoscape.js concentric layout; center node highlighted; 280px height. site/src/pages/graph.astro modified: replaced canvas plus inline force-graph script with GlobalGraph component. site/src/pages/nodes/[id].astro modified: added LocalGraph neighborhood section above related nodes. README.md modified: added Phase 6 Agent API section with REST and MCP usage and MCP config JSON.

title: Evidence
text: Python test suite: 47 out of 47 passing. Astro production build: 178 pages built in 746ms, build complete. New dependencies added: fastapi and uvicorn for REST API runtime, mcp version 1.27.1 for MCP protocol library, httpx as dev dependency required by FastAPI TestClient via starlette. All 5 sprints from the finish-agentwiki.md plan executed and verified. Zero build errors, zero test failures.

title: Open Questions
text: The MCP server has not been end-to-end tested with a live Claude Desktop or Claude Code session — only unit tested. A manual smoke test against the compiled dist/ would confirm the stdio transport works correctly in practice. The REST API search endpoint uses naive case-insensitive substring matching on title and type. Future improvement: wire it to the existing Pagefind or LanceDB index for richer relevance ranking. Node ID encoding (colon to double-underscore, slash to dash) is duplicated between Python _id_to_filename and TypeScript idToSlug — could be consolidated into a shared utility or documented contract. Phase 5 tree-sitter codebase integration remains marked as incomplete in CLAUDE.md, though getCodeSymbols is referenced in the node detail page — the full tree-sitter extraction pipeline was not implemented in this session.
